svg.text: BED v8 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Use the four side and two foot drawer ID sets: widths differ; do not swap fronts.
2. Join Bottom between Sides, then Back. Clamp square before fixing Front.
3. Fix four plywood pads under Bottom, then four fixed-direction 25.4 mm wheels.
4. Assumed total caster height is 35 mm. Measure actual height and plate before cutting.
5. Align wheel rolling direction with drawer travel. Test on the actual level room floor.
